text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
-- France grants Morocco 350 million franc loan to develop irrigation system in south and save threatened 10,000 hectares devoted to citrus fruit growing.
-- Casablanca authorities start clean-up operation in shanty towns around city, following order from King Hassan for authorities to tackle the environment.
-- Morocco celebrates 41st anniversary of return of King Mohammed V from exile.
-- Princess Lalla Meryem presides at launch of UNICEF greeting cards campaign.

-- King Hassan congratulates Palestinian President Yasser Arafat on anniversary of announcement of a Palestinian state and his "struggle to realise the gains and satisfy just claims and, in first place, guarantee the dignity of the Palestinian people, security and peace for the people of the region and their right to a life of dignity".
